newsitem.title: ITALY: Montedison sells corporate head office.
newsitem.headline: Montedison sells corporate head office.

text.p: Montedison said it had sold its corporate headquarters in Milan to a leasing company called Selmabipiemme Leasing for 85.15 billion lire plus value added tax.
The company said in a statement that Selmabipiemme would lease back the building to Montedison subsidiary Edison Spa .
Edison would move into the building on a prime site in central Milan, Foro Bonaparte, in the next few months.
Montedison and Compart, which jointly occupy the building, were already in the process of moving to an alternative site in the centre of town, in Piazzetta Bossi. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
